title: EPIC: Rethinking Trust Regions for Autoregressive LLM Policies via Exact-KL Prefix Importance-Ratio Clipping
abstract: arXiv:2610.29999v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) based on PPO-style clipping has become an effective approach to improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, standard token-level clipping measures policy change only through the conditional probability of the current token, while the prefix conditioning context is itself generated by the policy. This mismatch becomes especially consequential in long-response and off-policy training. We reformulate autoregressive generation as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and derive its performance-difference identity under behavior-policy sampling. The resulting change of measure identifies the cumulative likelihood ratio of the generated prefix as the exact importance weight for each stepwise policy-improvement term. Starting from the monotonic-improvement principle of trust-region policy optimization, we then construct a prefix-level trust region using the exact reverse-KL coord

translated_title: EPIC：通过精确KL前缀重要性比率裁剪重新思考自回归大语言模型策略的信任域
translated_abstract: 基于PPO式裁剪的强化学习（RL）已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的有效方法。然而，标准的token级裁剪仅通过当前token的条件概率来衡量策略变化，而作为条件的生成前缀本身也是由策略产生的。这种不匹配在长响应和离策略（off-policy）训练场景中尤其严重。我们将自回归生成重新表述为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，并在行为策略采样下推导出其性能差恒等式。由此得到的测度变换表明，所生成前缀的累积似然比正是每一步策略改进项的精确重要性权重。从信任域策略优化（TRPO）的单调改进原则出发，我们进而利用精确的反向KL（reverse-KL）构建了前缀级信任域（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出EPIC方法，将自回归生成建模为有限时域MDP并推导性能差恒等式，证明生成前缀的累积似然比才是逐步策略改进的精确重要性权重，并据此用精确反向KL裁剪构建前缀级信任域，从而修正标准PPO token级裁剪忽略前缀分布偏移所导致的偏差。
en_tdlr: EPIC reformulates autoregressive LLM generation as a finite-horizon MDP to prove that the cumulative prefix likelihood ratio is the exact importance weight for each policy-improvement term, and builds a prefix-level trust region via exact reverse-KL clipping, correcting the bias of standard token-level PPO clipping.
